**MEMO**

**To:** All Hourly Employees
**From:** Marisa Gomez, President
**Date:** December 15
**Re:** Payroll Processing

The accounting department will begin transferring employee information into the new online timekeeping system on or around January 2. The system will be operational beginning on February 1. Starting on that date, all employees must enter their work hours into the online system daily. January 31 is the last date on which the accounting department will accept the old paper timesheets.

Christopher Van Pelt will be leading a tutorial on the new system on January 15. To sign up, please call him at ext. 478.
reading.completedPassage:
Hourly employees will begin using a new online timekeeping system on February 1. They must enter work hours online daily and may sign up for a tutorial.

**Dịch:** Nhân viên làm theo giờ sẽ bắt đầu dùng hệ thống chấm công trực tuyến mới từ ngày 1 tháng Hai. Từ ngày đó, mọi nhân viên phải nhập giờ làm việc của mình lên hệ thống mỗi ngày. Nhân viên có thể đăng ký buổi hướng dẫn về hệ thống mới với Christopher Van Pelt.

**Hochstein to Be Headed by Barrault Bondy Executive**

February 10 - Recent movement of executives among the fashion industry's leading companies appears not to be ending anytime soon. Hochstein Shoes, Inc., a Swiss-based retailer and manufacturer of men's shoes, announced today that its chief executive officer, Gerard Hullot, will retire, and that Angelica Ferrara, current executive vice president of Barrault Bondy, will take his place.

Experts say the succession represents a major upset within the industry, since Barrault Bondy, the Paris-based manufacturer, is one of Hochstein's leading competitors in the high-end shoe market.

Hullot's departure comes as little surprise. He had publicly indicated his desire to retire in order to write a memoir of his long career in fashion, over thirty years of which were spent at Hochstein. Most experts had expected him to stay on until after November, when the company's winter collection is released.

Sources at Barrault Bondy indicate that current design director Marcel Hugo will be named the new executive vice president in a press release later this week.
reading.completedPassage:
Hochstein Shoes will replace its retiring CEO Gerard Hullot with Angelica Ferrara from competitor Barrault Bondy. Barrault Bondy is expected to announce Marcel Hugo as Ferrara's replacement.

**Dịch:** Hochstein Shoes sẽ thay thế giám đốc điều hành sắp nghỉ hưu Gerard Hullot bằng Angelica Ferrara, người hiện là phó chủ tịch điều hành của đối thủ Barrault Bondy. Việc này gây chú ý trong ngành thời trang vì hai công ty là đối thủ trong thị trường giày cao cấp. Barrault Bondy dự kiến sẽ công bố Marcel Hugo là người thay thế Ferrara trong tuần này.

**Welcome to the Smythe and Lewes team!**

We look forward to helping you build a career with us. We pride ourselves on the professionalism of our employees. Therefore, we offer the following tips to help you serve customers better and make your work as productive as possible.

We specialize in well-made formal and business attire for men and women from respected manufacturers. We expect employees to wear similar attire at work, and we encourage you to wear products from our stores. Therefore, we offer you a 40% discount on all merchandise including shoes and accessories at all Smythe and Lewes locations.

Customers expect Smythe and Lewes employees to be knowledgeable about our inventory. Please make an effort to familiarize yourself with it. This task is best reserved for periods when there are fewer customers in the store in the morning for weekday shifts and at night before closing for weekend shifts. As our inventory changes from week to week, this needs to be an ongoing process.
reading.completedPassage:
Smythe and Lewes welcomes new employees and explains expectations. Employees should wear professional clothing, receive a store discount, and study the store inventory so they can help customers confidently.

**Dịch:** Smythe and Lewes chào mừng nhân viên mới và giải thích các kỳ vọng trong công việc. Nhân viên nên mặc trang phục chuyên nghiệp, có thể nhận giảm giá 40% khi mua hàng tại cửa hàng, và cần tìm hiểu hàng tồn kho để tự tin trả lời câu hỏi của khách hàng.

**WoodSmith, Inc.**

We are pleased you have purchased handmade, hardwood furniture from WoodSmith, Inc. of Vancouver. We are proud of our long heritage and are confident you will appreciate the quality and craftsmanship that went into the making of your product. Our furniture is meant to last a lifetime. That is why we make every effort to inform our customers how best to treat it. We recommend the following:

- Use cleaning products made specifically for wood, such as Bly's Wood Cleaner.
- Avoid multi-surface cleaners, as these may leave streaks or an oily residue.
- To brighten a surface that has dulled, use a paste wax such as Russ Wax. Apply the wax no more than twice per year.
- Avoid wiping the furniture with a dry cloth, as this may leave hairline scratches.
- Avoid placing the furniture directly in front of radiators, heating ducts, and fireplaces.
- Do not expose the furniture to direct sunlight, as this may lead to fading.

We wish you a lifetime of enjoyment from your furniture. We appreciate your business and welcome your comments and suggestions.
reading.completedPassage:
WoodSmith gives care instructions for handmade hardwood furniture. Customers should use wood-specific cleaners and paste wax, avoid dry cloths and heat sources, and keep furniture out of direct sunlight to prevent fading.

**Dịch:** WoodSmith đưa ra hướng dẫn bảo quản đồ nội thất gỗ cứng làm thủ công. Khách hàng nên dùng chất tẩy rửa dành riêng cho gỗ và sáp đánh bóng, tránh dùng khăn khô, tránh đặt đồ nội thất gần nguồn nhiệt, và không để dưới ánh nắng trực tiếp để tránh phai màu.
